requirement: Allow clients in 10.0.1.0/24 to access the management network 10.0.99.0/24.

proposal.rationale: The requirement to allow clients in 10.0.1.0/24 to access the management network 10.0.99.0/24 can be satisfied by configuring an access rule on r1 (the client-facing router) that permits traffic from 10.0.1.0/24 to 10.0.99.0/24. Since r1 is connected to the client network and the transit link to r2, and r2 is responsible for reaching the management network, the access policy must be applied on r1 to allow this traffic. The static routes ensure that r1 can reach r2 via 10.0.12.2, and r2 can reach the management network through its own configuration (not required here), so no additional static routes are needed. The access policy is sufficient and within the constraints of the existing network topology and device capabilities.
